Thanks Eric!

Paul-indeed, those were from me. Yours is from the same seed batch, but different individuals. That seed batch was FILLED with high quality, vigorous plants. It'll be interesting to see how they look in your collection, and the nice thing is that they are still true to type. The parents to this seed batch were from the same population, but two really nice individuals.
